title: RiskValidateRequest
description: Candidate setup signal for POST /risk/validate. Same shape as SetupSignal except id is optional — ML assigns id only after approval when publishing to setup_signals.

id.description: Optional on validate. Required on setup_signals publish.

setup_type.description: Pluggable. Placeholder enum in quant/README (six USME/ICT names) until ML Researchers lock the list.

invalidation.description: Structure / invalidation level. Stop is placed beyond this.

atr.description: ATR(14) in price units. Used when stop is omitted.

equity.description: Override account equity for this call.
